manual.alloy_kiln.line2: {0}The Alloy Kiln is a simple furnace made out of heat resistant sandstone and bricks. Within it, temperatures are high enough to allow metals to be melted into a fluid state and mixed, creating an {1}alloy{2}.
manual.alloy_kiln.line3: This allows the creation of important alloys like Electrum and Constantan without the tedious mixing of dusts.{0}
manual.alloy_kiln.line4: {0}To form the Kiln, arrange 8 of the Kiln Bricks in a 2x2x2 cube, as shown above, and rightclick one of the sides' blocks with an Engineer's Hammer.{1}
manual.alloy_kiln.line5: {0}The alloy kiln is also essential in the creation of §2insulating glass§r, a component used in the construction of {1}high-voltage architecture{2}.
